rca of the issue: During iter106as, the main agent replaced the raw <Image> avatar block in app/trainee/session-detail.tsx L262-267 with a new <UserAvatar ...> JSX block at L265-272 but omitted adding the corresponding `import { UserAvatar } from '../../src/components/UserAvatar'` line at the top of the file. All other 6 migrated files include the import (verified via `grep -c '^import.*UserAvatar' <file>` returning 1). The oversight is confined to this single file. Reproduction: (1) `cd /app && git diff frontend/app/trainee/session-detail.tsx` shows only JSX changes at L263-272, no import diff. (2) `cd /app/frontend && grep -n 'UserAvatar' app/trainee/session-detail.tsx` returns only the usage at L265, no import. (3) `cd /app/frontend && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | grep session-detail` returns `TS2304: Cannot find name 'UserAvatar'`. Mitigation: add `import { UserAvatar } from '../../src/components/UserAvatar';` between the existing L25 and L26 imports (or grouped with other component imports).
